scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation plus finite independent numerical quadrature checks; no claim of independent proof validation.
scientific_limitations: One Haar-uniform direction; planar nondegenerate triangles; centroidal unnormalized polar inertia. No statement for arbitrary convex bodies or random multi-step rates. title: Shape-independent angular response and a sharp contraction threshold for triangular \(\lambda\)-Steiner symmetrization
